title: The stalker
description:
This project adds atmospheric stalker entities that silently observe players from the shadows. 
These mysterious beings appear in dark corners, behind windows, and in caves, creating an unsettling horror experience in Minecraft.
body:
STALKER MOD - Atmospheric Horror Experience

This mod introduces a sophisticated horror system featuring unique stalker entities that create a constant sense of unease and paranoia in your Minecraft world. Unlike traditional hostile mobs, these entities are designed purely for psychological horror - they observe.

This is still an alpha version.
It may contain many bugs.

Command test:
/stalker
